description: HAL TIM4 update interrupt as a 1 kHz time base: PB12 toggled every 1 ms, PC13 heartbeat 1 Hz
expect: 72 MHz; TIM4 PSC 71, ARR 999 on TIMXCLK1 = 72 MHz: an update event every 72000 cycles = 1.000 ms (UIF cleared before HAL_TIM_Base_Start_IT, so the first interrupt comes one period after the start). Each TIM4 interrupt (IRQ 30, HAL_TIM_PeriodElapsedCallback) toggles PB12 push-pull: 500 Hz, 1.000 ms high / 1.000 ms low, no drift (+-0.2 us interrupt-latency jitter). Every 500th interrupt also toggles PC13 (on-board LED, active low, starts off): 1 Hz, 500 ms on / 500 ms off, each PC13 edge less than 2 us after a PB12 edge. The CPU sleeps in __WFI(). No UART.

circuit: PB12: logic analyzer probe (no load needed)
